tasks.label: Add user_clock_in route to routes/web.php
tasks.command: awk 'BEGIN{print ""}{print}' routes/web.php > /tmp/routes_web_php && awk 'NR==1,NR==20000{print}' /tmp/routes_web_php > /tmp/routes_web_php2 && mv /tmp/routes_web_php2 routes/web.php && echo "\n// User TimeLog routes\nRoute::post('/user/timelog/clock-in', [App\\Http\\Controllers\\Application\\TimeLogController::class, 'user_clock_in'])->name('user_clock_in');" >> routes/web.php && php -l routes/web.php || true;
tasks.explanation: Append a POST route for user_clock_in to routes/web.php and validate syntax with php -l.
